_finding: Both issuers publish their reference in TOKEN units: Coinbase's nav_price is total return (the multiplier already in it) and Robinhood's tokenBid/tokenAsk are already scaled. The Solana module this was modelled on multiplies the share price by the multiplier, and copied as it is that formula would show a premium the size of the multiplier on every token whose multiplier is not 1. These mutations put that error back, and drop the rule that only a pool in which the token is the BASE side prices it.

mutations.name: the multiplier is applied to a reference that already carries it
mutations.expect: FAIL a token at its reference shows no premium whatever its multiplier
mutations._note: The defect the Base phase-0 review named: an invented premium equal to the multiplier.

mutations.name: a quote-side pool is priced with the base token's price
mutations.find: return usd > 0 && nat > 0 ? { price: usd / nat, side: 'quote' } : null
mutations.replace: return usd > 0 ? { price: usd, side: 'quote' } : null
mutations.expect: FAIL a quote-side pool is priced by inversion: priceUsd / priceNative
mutations._note: DexScreener's priceUsd prices the base token; read off a pool where our token is the quote without inverting, it is someone else's price.

mutations.name: the shallowest pool prices the token
mutations.expect: FAIL of two eligible pools the deeper one prices the token

mutations.name: a wide reference quote is used anyway
mutations.find: if (spread != null && (spread < 0 || spread > MAX_REFERENCE_SPREAD)) return out('reference_spread_wide')
mutations.expect: FAIL a reference quote wider than 1% refuses the premium
mutations._note: Measured 08.11: Robinhood's weekend quotes ran several percent wide; a mid against them reads the spread as a gap.

mutations.name: a pool against any token prices a stock token
mutations.expect: FAIL a pool against a memecoin does not price a stock token, however deep
mutations._note: Robinhood Chain, 09.11: memecoins paired with DJT gave DJT at ~$990 against an issuer price of ~$4.

mutations.name: the other token is matched by symbol, not address
mutations.expect: FAIL ...and a look-alike symbol is not the reference asset: the address is

mutations.name: two sources that disagree on the deepest pool still give a premium
mutations.find: if (cross > 0 && Math.abs(best.price_usd / cross - 1) > MAX_SOURCE_DISAGREEMENT) return out('sources_disagree')
mutations.expect: FAIL the chain and the aggregator more than 2% apart refuse the premium as sources_disagree
